title: Automated Client Inquiry Triage for Boutique Agencies
business: Boutique creative agencies managing high volumes of client communication.
problem: Manual sorting of incoming emails leads to delayed responses and missed project requirements, causing client dissatisfaction.
solution: Using the Hostinger Mail plugin, agencies can automate the inspection of incoming mailboxes and folders to categorize inquiries based on content, allowing for faster, context-aware drafting of responses directly within the chat interface.
steps: Authenticate the Hostinger Mail plugin with the agency's primary support mailbox.
Instruct the AI to inspect specific folders for unread messages from identified client domains.
Use the search and read message capabilities to extract key project requirements from the email body.
Draft and send structured email replies based on the extracted context using the plugin's send email function.
outcome: Improved response consistency and reduced administrative overhead, allowing account managers to focus on creative strategy rather than manual email sorting.
limitation: The plugin relies on the accuracy of the AI's natural language understanding to categorize emails; users should verify the classification of complex or ambiguous messages by checking the mailbox state manually.
